title: Add-on gating experiment: contract questionnaire integration and tiered observability bundling
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Run a controlled experiment to validate a bundled offering that ties: (1) tiered observability retention levels, (2) a Compliance Pack feature set, and (3) an optional Premium SLA to contract questionnaire responses and entitlement gating. The goal is to identify monetizable add-on bundles that enterprise buyers are willing to accept in contract negotiation and to ensure automated entitlement flow for self-serve and sales-assisted signups. This ticket is the cross-functional playbook for PM/Design/Eng/Legal to execute the pilot.
hypothesis: Enterprise customers who answer the security questionnaire and commit to an annual entitlements contract will opt into a mid-tier observability retention bundle + compliance pack at >= 18% attachment rate with a net ARR uplift of $75k per pilot cohort and no material increase in support load.
success_metrics: attachment_rate: percent of eligible contracts that accept the bundle >= 18%
ARR_uplift: average uplift per pilot account >= $75,000
time_to_close: change in sales cycle for accounts offered the bundle (target: <= +7 days)
support_volume: no more than +10% increase in enterprise support tickets for onboarding
acceptance_criteria: Automated gating: questionnaire answers map to entitlements in the Contract UI and backend (beta rollout to 10 pilot accounts)
Billing: subscription SKU and metering for observability retention tiers correctly appear in invoices in test tenant
Console: per-route retention UI shows projected monthly cost delta and rollout toggle to enable bundle
Legal: security questionnaire and contract language approved by Legal and Security
approach: 1) Define three bundle SKUs (Essential, Compliant, Premium SLA) with observability retention tiers; 2) Integrate questionnaire to produce a risk score and recommended bundle; 3) Add entitlement flags and automated contract clause template for sales flow; 4) Pilot with 8 enterprise customers via sales-assisted outreach; 5) Measure attachment and operational impacts, iterate.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Overly aggressive pricing deters buyers -> Mitigation: run price sensitivity cell for two cohorts with 10% price delta
Risk: Entitlement automation mismatch -> Mitigation: end-to-end test plan including contract generation, billing SKU reconciliation, and audit log verification
Risk: Security review delays -> Mitigation: parallel review with Security and a gated MVP that surfaces questionnaire results to Legal for manual approval initially
